messages:
Sam Turner: Quick heads-up — final POC readout with Lena (Kestrel Retail) tomorrow 2pm PT. Need consolidated metrics, top 3 blockers, and pricing ask. Slides due EOD. @Priya @Ben

Priya Shah: I'll pull perf metrics and cost calc. Any preferred format? CSV + one-slide summary ok?

Ben Chu: CSV + single-slide summary pls. I'll extract p50/p95, tokens, error-rate, and inference cost.

Lena Park: Thanks — we'll join. Primary success criteria were: 1) extraction accuracy >= 92% on receipts, 2) p95 latency < 300ms, 3) throughput 50rps sustained. We ran ~5k items across 3 stores.

Sam Turner: Great. Ben — can you confirm numbers from the final runs?

Ben Chu: From the final run on Dedicated-sim: p50=120ms, p95=320ms, throughput peak=58rps, avg inference cost ~$0.011 per 1k tokens, extraction F1=90.8% on the full eval set. Small sample notes attached in slide 4.

Priya Shah: F1 is slightly below their target. Quick prompt changes + reranker pushed to F1=92.1 on a 500-sample holdout but token cost rose ~8%.

Sam Turner: Can you paste the eval snippet and the exact prompts you'll propose for the readout?

Priya Shah: ```
# Eval snippet
prompt template:
"Extract merchant, date, total, and line_items as JSON. Provide only JSON.
Example 1: ..."
Few-shot with 3 examples.
results (holdout 500): F1=92.1, precision=91.5, recall=92.7
```

Lena Park: Is any finetune required to hit 92% consistently? If so what's the timeline and cost?

Ben Chu: No finetune required for current target. Prompt engineering + small reranker gave the lift. If they want a model finetune: estimate 2-3 weeks of labeled data + infra (~$12k) and a short validation run. Recommend as an optional path if they require consistent >93.5%.

Sam Turner: Security/questions — Lena, you mentioned SSO and SOC2. Any outstanding asks?

Lena Park: Security team asked for: a) KMS support for key rotation, b) data retention / deletion controls, c) certs for SOC2. We answered most of the questionnaire but still need a concise customer-facing blurb on retention and KMS rotation policy.

Sam Turner: @Priya can you confirm Redwood Private support and the blurb so we can include it in slides?

Priya Shah: Confirmed: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS, configurable retention windows (30/90/365 days), and audit logs. I'll paste the blurb in the deck: "Customer KMS + rotation policies supported; retention configurable per route; full audit logs available for Private deployments."

Ben Chu: Also call out that we used prefix caching for repeated template receipts — saved ~22% token cost on production-like traffic. Will put a micro-chart in perf slide.

Sam Turner: Pricing ask: they want a committed-capacity quote for 6 months with a path to production (dedicated pool). Finance needs the worst-case qps and monthly token spend.

Priya Shah: I'll run two commit scenarios: (A) 50rps sustained commit with 10% burst buffer, (B) 100rps commit with lower per-token. Will model discounts and show committed vs on-demand. I'll have numbers by 6pm.

Lena Park: One ask from PM: include 3 representative failing examples and what mitigations we propose (prompt fix, reranker, fallback to human review).

Ben Chu: I'll add 3 annotated failures and short remediation steps.

Sam Turner: For the readout agenda: 1) Exec summary & KPIs, 2) Technical runbook (perf/cost), 3) Security & compliance answers, 4) Pricing and contract path, 5) Open gaps and recommended mitigations, 6) Next steps. Who's presenting which?

Priya Shah: I'll cover slides 1 and 5 (KPIs + mitigations)

Ben Chu: I'll take slide 2 (perf/cost) and the failure examples

Sam Turner: I'll handle slide 4 (pricing/contract) and the expansion ask (dedicated + retained logs)

Lena Park: Sounds good. Minor: can you include a one-paragraph SLO note we can hand to ops?

Priya Shah: Adding SLO note: "p50 target 150ms, p95 target 300ms on Dedicated; 99.9% availability SLA on reserve plan. Fallback policy: lower-cost model variant for bursts over commit."

Automated Meeting Bot: Meeting scheduled — POC Readout with Kestrel Retail on 2024-06-28 14:00 PT. Dial-in: https://zoom.link/abcd1234

Sam Turner: Thanks all. Please upload final PDF deck in #sales by EOD so I can send to their execs.

Priya Shah: Uploaded: `1717008123-kestrel-trial-deck.pdf` :thumbsup:

Lena Park: Received. See you tomorrow.
